text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking around for Trainer Kiryuin to
invite
her out for the day, when...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Now let's focus on timing. Lightly plant
your toes,
and use your right foot as a
pivot point.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: My right foot...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Correct. Keep your movements small,
and
remember to stay flexible.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
How about it? Do you think you can do
it?

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: ...Let me think.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After saying that, Happy Meek moves
over by the
window.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At a glance, it appears like she's just
staring
blankly at the sky.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Trainer Kiryuin watches her placidly.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This continues on, undisturbed, for
about thirty
minutes.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer
<username>!
Nice
to see you!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Something akin to visualization.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
She likes to imagine her own movements
while
gazing up at the sky. That's just
how she's always
done it.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
All I can do is watch over her until she
feels she's
got it.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
As per the Trainer's Handbook, "One
should
respect the heart of an
Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, another thirty minutes pass.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When Happy Meek returns, she
performs the
dance flawlessly.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Surprised?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, thanks. That's one of her many
talents.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Once she's able to visualize something,
she can
do it perfectly without any
further issues.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Of course, she still needs the physical
prowess to
perfectly execute the
movements in her head.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
But since she's always training hard,
that's no
problem for her.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
It's no easy task to keep working like
that.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I really respect her, from the bottom of
my heart.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: You do?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Having a respectable trainee is one of
the
greatest joys a trainer can
experience, wouldn't
you say?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
But... there's another person who I also
respect.
Someone very close by, in fact.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, it's a little embarrassing... Let's
just say it's
a secret.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer <username>.

From here on out, both as peers and as
rivals...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Let's keep giving it our best!
